basic_info.name: M2D-CLAP (M2D-CLAP: Masked Modeling Duo Meets CLAP; 2024 Interspeech version + 2024/2025 extended versions)
basic_info.org: NTT Communication Science Laboratories / NTT CS Lab (Daisuke Niizumi, Daiki Takeuchi, Yasunori Ohishi, Noboru Harada, Masahiro Yasuda, Shunsuke Tsubaki, Keisuke Imoto)
basic_info.release_date: Interspeech 2024 paper (arXiv 2406.02032, Jun 2024); follow-up 'M2D-CLAP: Exploring General-purpose Audio-Language Representations Beyond CLAP' published in IEEE Access 2025 [uncertain exact publication date]; M2D-CLAP_2025 weights released on GitHub (release 'M2D-CLAP (2025) Weights')
basic_info.links: paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.02032 (Interspeech 2024) ; code: https://github.com/nttcslab/m2d (clap/ subdir) ; checkpoints: GitHub Releases (e.g. m2d_clap_vit_base-80x1001p16x16p16kpBpTI-2025.zip); paper HF page: https://huggingface.co/papers/2406.02032 (no official HF model hub [uncertain])

architecture.backbone: Audio encoder: Masked Modeling Duo (M2D) ViT-base ('m2d_clap_vit_base-80x1001p16x16p16kpBpTI-2025'; sliding-window input, 80 mel bands x 1001 frames; a 2025 variant with 80x2 stride gives 20 ms temporal resolution). Text: Stage 1 uses pre-computed LLM-based sentence embeddings (no text encoder at training); Stage 2/2.1 fine-tunes a BERT text encoder. Total audio encoder ~ 88M params [uncertain]
architecture.training_objective: Multi-stage: Stage 1 jointly trains audio encoder with M2D masked modeling distillation AND CLAP-style contrastive audio-language alignment; Stage 1.1 AudioSet fine-tune; Stage 2 CLAP-only fine-tuning (AudioCaps+Clotho added, BERT text encoder fine-tuned on the fly); Stage 2.1 further CLAP refinement (WavCaps+AudioCaps+Clotho, no masking). Contrastive part is standard CLAP InfoNCE-style alignment
architecture.embedding_output: Global CLAP-style audio embedding for retrieval (dim not fully verified, likely 768 from ViT-base [uncertain]) + an audio-only representation usable for transfer learning; frame-level temporal resolution supported (encoder is a ViT over patch sequences; 2025 checkpoint explicitly advertises 20 ms temporal resolution for dense features)

data.training_data: AudioSet + VGGSound + WavCaps captions for Stage 1 (millions of clips); WavCaps + AudioCaps + Clotho for Stage 2/2.1; AS2M (AudioSet 2M) fine-tuning for encoder-only variants; dataset mix license follows AudioSet/WavCaps terms (WavCaps is CC-BY-4.0; AudioSet audios are YouTube-sourced, research-oriented) [uncertain]

performance.benchmarks: Zero-shot classification: GTZAN 75.17% (claimed SOTA at Interspeech 2024 publication). General-purpose repertoire: AS2M mAP 0.490 (M2D-CLAP_2025), 0.485 (2024 AS-FT variant); strong on audio tagging (AT), sound event detection (SED), linear evaluation, fine-tuning, and audio-language (Clotho/AudioCaps retrieval, MACS) [uncertain exact retrieval numbers]; embedding-family (not LLM-family)
performance.vs_clap: Outperforms standard CLAP (e.g. LAION-CLAP / Microsoft-CLAP) on GTZAN zero-shot (75.17 vs lower baselines [uncertain exact delta]) and on transfer-learning/probing tasks because M2D masked modeling is retained alongside contrastive alignment; designed for both zero-shot and regression/transfer tasks where CLAP fails

availability.license: Code MIT (nttcslab/m2d repo) [uncertain]; checkpoints publicly downloadable from GitHub Releases without login; intended research use — verify checkpoint license terms in the release [uncertain]

fit_for_local_playlist.sample_rate: 16 kHz standard M2D-CLAP input (one archived 2024 variant supports 32 kHz); requires resampling from repo-standard 48k mono
fit_for_local_playlist.inference_cost: ViT-base audio encoder (~88M params [uncertain]) + BERT text encoder (~110M); single 10 s clip encoding is fast; runs on CPU with acceptable latency [uncertain]; GPU recommended for library-scale sweeps
fit_for_local_playlist.full_track_context: Fixed sliding window of 10 s ('80x1001' patch config) + 20 ms-step variant for dense attention; longer tracks need windowed inference + aggregation (no native long-context support)
fit_for_local_playlist.frame_level_support: Yes — ViT over patches with optional 20 ms temporal resolution checkpoint ('m2d_clap_vit_base-80x1001p80x2p16kpBpTI-2025') supports frame-level temporal features
fit_for_local_playlist.retrieval_steering: No explicit attribute-control; relies on prompt engineering; M2D joint training gives a separate audio-only representation usable for non-text (tag/music) playlist logic but no LT-CLAP-style steerable retrieval
